https://armenopole.com/christmas-decor-a: Soussine leads a Christmas decor arrangement workshop in Québec, guiding participants to craft their own festive displays in a creative, convivial setting.
https://armenopole.com/ri1lm4at.html: The Cairo Chapter of the Armenian General Benevolent Union (AGBU) hosts a talk by British-Armenian historian Vahe Boghosian on Armenian life in Sudan from 1899 to 1956.
https://armenopole.com/chamber-music-1-v: The "Chamber Music 1" concert features original compositions for violin trio by Friedrich Hermann, Carl Mikuli, and Ernst Spies. Violinists Janna Dimont, Varvara Merzlova-Peneva, and Hasmik Sargsyan of the Cyprus Symphony Orchestra perform this chamber music program.
https://armenopole.com/z2wbav5b.html: The annual Armenian Bazaar in Attica features homemade delicacies prepared by the Ladies' Committee. Enjoy traditional sweets, savory pies, and Lenten dishes in a warm community gathering that supports the Committee's charitable work.
https://armenopole.com/julekoncert-de-le: The choir De Levende Sthene, conducted by Anahit Mughnetsyan with pianist Larysa Soloviova, presents a warm Christmas concert followed by a glass of wine.
https://armenopole.com/ucpxrdma.html: The Armenian Blue Cross, Nikaia chapter, hosts a bazaar featuring traditional Armenian foods and sweets in a warm, community-focused atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/familielejr.html: The family camp celebrates Pentecost together in Denmark. The local Armenian community organizes intergenerational activities in a festive and spiritual atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/phonethon-2026-fr: The Phonéthon 2026, organized by the Fonds Arménien de France, runs from 19 to 22 November under the patronage of Christian Makarian. This fundraiser supports vital projects in Armenia: aid for Artsakh refugees, agropastoral development, drinking water supply, and vocational training. Armenian schools in Lebanon and the rehabilitation of the Spandaryan canal will also benefit.
https://armenopole.com/atelier-de-cuisin: UGAB Lyon hosts a cooking workshop on sou-beureg, an Armenian dish of thin pastry layers and savory filling. Participants prepare the recipe step by step and then share the meal in a warm, intergenerational atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/concertos-avec-le: The Orchestre Da Capo accompanies soloists Iris Torossian, Magali Mosnier, Raphaël Jacob, and Florian Holbé for a classical program featuring Mozart, Bach, Vivaldi, and Grieg.
https://armenopole.com/la-cuisine-des-ar: Meet-and-greet and book signing at Cultura La Valentine bookstore with Corinne Zarzavatdjian for her book "La Cuisine des Arméniens", prefaced by Pascal Ory. The work traces Armenian history through 70 recipes and diaspora stories.
https://armenopole.com/0hnve3bw.html: St. Illuminator's Cathedral hosts a Thanksgiving luncheon after Soorp Badarak with lunch, wine, dessert, and music in Pashalian Hall.
https://armenopole.com/aahpo-medical-for: AAHPO hosts a medical forum on dementia and Alzheimer's at St. Thomas Armenian Church. Dr. Eliz Agopian, Dr. Cristian Ciora, and RN Joan Di Paola will answer questions, moderated by Dr. Garbis Baydar.
https://armenopole.com/the-naghash-ensem: The Naghash Ensemble of Armenia performs at The Conrad in La Jolla. Three female vocalists and Armenia's finest instrumentalists on duduk, oud, dhol, and piano present John Hodian's "Songs of Exile," setting medieval mystic Mkrtich Naghash's sacred texts to a blend of Armenian folk, new classical, post-minimalism, rock, and jazz.
https://armenopole.com/christmas-fair-un: The Armenian community hosts a Christmas Fair with lunch, dessert, drinks and a visit from Santa. The charitable event benefits the Armenian Relief Society of GB and also offers vendor tables.

https://armenopole.com/t62iudof.html: The Croix Bleue des Arméniens de France, ASTRIG section, hosts a friendly Beaujolais Nouveau tasting with an all-you-can-eat buffet. The event promises a warm moment of sharing and conviviality among Armenian community members.
https://armenopole.com/repas-traditionne: The Armenian Apostolic Church of Saint Mary Mother of God in Issy-les-Moulineaux hosts a traditional meal celebrating the 51st anniversary of its consecration. The Ladies' Committee organizes this warm, festive gathering.
https://armenopole.com/sur-les-pas-des-a: The Centre du patrimoine arménien offers a guided tour of its permanent trail tracing the history of Armenians who settled in Valence in the 1920s. A mediator leads participants through content updated for the Cpa's 20th anniversary.
https://armenopole.com/l-exil-de-katerin: L'Exil de Katerina is a Greek-Armenian performance blending storytelling, Greek songs, Armenian music and dance. Created in 2026 by Catherine Pounardjian, it features Maria Dinas, Michael, Gayané and Christine Papazian on stage.
https://armenopole.com/h2dmmyy7.html: Les Nuits Arméniennes return for a third edition in Nouvelle-Aquitaine. Organised by the Stop Crohn’O association, this multidisciplinary festival celebrates Armenian culture through concerts, shows, cinema, exhibitions and gastronomy. Featured artists include Trio Ararat, Bal’Anoush, Frédo, Marion Mezadorian, Collectif Étrange Miroir, Velw and patron Simon Abkarian.
https://armenopole.com/brahms-between-pa: Cellist Hasmik Vardanyan leads a Brahms program with tenor Mark Swindler, violist Omeed Manshouri, and pianist Alina Klimaszewska, featuring a cello sonata, arranged songs, art songs, and Hungarian Dances.
https://armenopole.com/les-nuits-armenie: Les Nuits Arméniennes returns for its 3rd edition on Île d'Oléron. Organised by Stop Crohn'O, this multidisciplinary festival blends music, cinema, visual arts and gastronomy. Highlights include Trio Ararat concerts, Marion Mezdorian's show, Robert Guédiguian's film with Simon Abkarian, an Armenian dance evening, and the ARMAD collective exhibition.
https://armenopole.com/spectacle-et-pres: The Abovian Association hosts a performance and book presentation marking the 50th anniversary of the Abovian School. Featured participants include writer Edvard Militonyan, president of the Writers Union of Armenia, and poet Anush Vardanyan.
https://armenopole.com/kilikia-mon-amour: GAIDZ Nor Serount marks its 40th anniversary with an Armenian concert at Notre-Dame d'Alfortville church. Soprano, kanun, duduk and student choirs perform traditional and classical pieces. Free admission, emotional and cultural atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/exposition-6-arti: The group exhibition ARMAD – Racines brings together six artists of Armenian origin at L'Arsenal in Château-d'Oléron, as part of the Nuits Arméniennes. Sculpture, photography, painting, and printmaking explore identity, memory, and transmission through the lens of heritage and modernity.
https://armenopole.com/metamorphosis.htm: Streeters gallery, the younger sister of The Holy Art, presents Metamorphosis in New York. This group exhibition gathers international artists exploring transformation through painting, photography, sculpture, and digital work. The festive opening features music, drinks, and the artists in attendance.
https://armenopole.com/lilit-pipoyan-liv: Armenian musician Lilit Pipoyan performs in New York as part of her international tour. She blends Armenian poetry, folklore, and medieval secular songs with contemporary arrangements. An intimate concert featuring guitar, piano, and string instruments.
https://armenopole.com/annual-bazar-cana: The annual Christmas Bazaar of the Croix de Secours Arménienne de Laval returns on 5–6 December 2026 under the patronage of Mme Anahid Minassian. Held at the Centre communautaire arménien de Laval, it features crafts, treats and holiday finds in a warm, festive atmosphere. Proceeds support the association's activities.
https://armenopole.com/holiday-cheer-sui: Sinfonia Toronto, conducted by Nurhan Arman, presents "Holiday Cheer Reflections" featuring Armenian violinist Nuné Melik. The program includes works by Ananyan and Hovhannes, plus Canadian and Ontario premieres in a festive year-end celebration.
https://armenopole.com/taline-and-friend: Taline and Friends presents a children's show featuring characters such as a clown, dolphin, and leopard. The event is organized by the group Taline and Friends in a fun, family-friendly atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/soorp-badarak-ded: Soorp Badarak led by Archbishop Anoushavan Tanielian, Prelate of the Eastern Prelacy, featuring the dedication of the renovated entry vestibule, the parish Name Day of St. Gregory the Illuminator, and the 20th anniversary of Rev. Archpriest Bedros Shetilian's pastoral service.
https://armenopole.com/continuum.html: The group exhibition "Continuum" marks the 10th anniversary of the LMNO gallery in Brussels. It brings together works by Dominique Blain, Philippe De Gobert, Detanico & Lain, Christine Dupuis & Thorsten Baensch, Denicolai & Provoost, Maria Friberg, Aïda Kazarian, Adrien Lucca, Anahita Norouzi, and Pep Vidal.
https://armenopole.com/view-of-ararat.ht: Artist Taihei Soejima gives a talk and presentation at Armenian House in London, exploring views of Ararat.
https://armenopole.com/incontriamo-rita-: Rita Tekeyan, a Lebanese national of Armenian origin and Italian citizen, is the guest of honor for the 32nd anniversary of the Assadakah association. The event is organized by Assadakah, Welcome Association Italy, IRIS, and the Hamazkayin Armenian School.
https://armenopole.com/paesaggi-e-musica: A meeting with Garen Kökciyan, who delivers an audiovisual presentation on major figures of Armenian music from Sayat Nova to Aznavour, accompanied by images of Armenian landscapes. Nairi Ghazaryan performs cello interludes, blending music, history and scenery.
